news.title: Northern Michigan found a way to cut school absenteeism. Lansing may defund it
news.summary_en: One reason Michigan is behind other states in test scores is because kids miss so much school. But a program hailed as a model is at risk of losing nearly half its funding.
news.author: Ron French

news.title: Attracting Michigan preschoolers, teachers with free housing, other innovations
news.summary_en: A shortage of early childhood educators and the lack of child care options in some areas have inspired innovative solutions in Michigan. They include a free housing program in Battle Creek and converting space in a Grand Rapids transit facility into a child-care center.
news.author: Martin Slagter, Chalkbeat
